svg.text: CONVERTER 80 bar g IN; V-201 75 bar g / 40 C; FEED 1928 kNm3/h;
MAKE-UP 366 kNm3/h; PURGE 105 kNm3/h; MeOH 112.5 t/h; Q(RXN) 85 MW.
1. DESIGN BASIS (REFERENCE CARD): 900 kt/y CH3OH AT 8000 h/y = 112.5 t/h; QUENCH CONVERTER, FIXED BED, GAS PHASE, 220-280 C, 50-100 bar, Cu/ZnO/Al2O3, GHSV 8000-12000 1/h. OTS DESIGN: 80 bar g INLET,

184 m3 CATALYST (12/20/28/40 %, 1150 kg/m3), GHSV 10 500 1/h, FEED 1928 kNm3/h; BED TEMPERATURES AND FLOWS FROM THE OTS HEAT AND MASS BALANCE (KINETICS VANDEN BUSSCHE & FROMENT 1996, ASSUMED) - PLANT VALUES TBC.
2. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY (GAS 20 m/s, LIQUID 2 m/s) - TBC BY PIPING. SERVICE CODES: PG PROCESS GAS, SG SYNGAS, PU PURGE, CM CRUDE METHANOL, HS HP STEAM, SC CONDENSATE, CW COOLING WATER, FL FLARE.
3. COLD SHOTS ENTER THROUGH LOZENGE DISTRIBUTORS ABOVE BEDS 2-4; TIC-221/231/241 MEASURE JUST BELOW EACH DISTRIBUTOR. QUENCH VALVES AND TV-211 FAIL OPEN (CONVERTER GOES COLDER ON AIR FAILURE).
4. TSHH-2xx: ANY OF THE BED MULTIPOINT THERMOCOUPLES TE-212...244 ABOVE 300 C FOR 5 s (VOTING TBC) - I-1 CLOSES XV-202 (MAKE-UP) AND FORCES HV-214 SHUT; C-201 KEEPS CIRCULATING TO COOL THE BEDS.
5. E-204 START-UP HEATER (HP STEAM, MAX 30 MW) IN SERVICE ONLY TO HEAT THE CATALYST TO ~210 C BEFORE MAKE-UP GAS IS ADMITTED; HV-214 BLOCKED IN DURING NORMAL OPERATION.
6. PDI-215...245 TAPS ABOVE AND BELOW EACH BED (NOT SHOWN). CONVERTER RELIEF IS PROVIDED BY PSV-201 ON V-201 (MEOH-PID-002); CATALYST DUMP NOZZLES, MANWAYS, VENTS AND DRAINS NOT SHOWN.
7. TIC-211 SETS THE BED 1 INLET BY BYPASSING PART OF THE BED-1 FEED AROUND THE COLD SIDE OF E-201 (FEED/EFFLUENT POSITIVE FEEDBACK - TUNE SLOW, CHECK AFTER ANY RATE CHANGE).
CHULA CHEM. ENG. - METHANOL CONVERTER VER 1 (OTS)
